name: pure-bugfix-with-regression-test
description: Fixes the seeded off-by-one in allocate() (`index < leftover - 1` -> `index < leftover`) and adds regression tests that fail on base and pass on head. One-line fix, two files, entirely inside the plan's scopePaths, no API or dependency change. The model Lane 0 change.

claim.title: Fix allocate() losing a minor unit on uneven splits

plan.title: Fix allocate() losing a minor unit on uneven splits
plan.intent: allocate() promises shares that add up to exactly the total, but when the total does not divide evenly it drops one minor unit: splitting EUR 1.00 three ways returns 33 + 33 + 33 cents. Hand out every leftover minor unit, first share first, and pin the behaviour with a regression test.
acceptanceCriteria: For any total (including negative totals) and valid ratios, the shares sum to exactly the total
A regression test fails before the fix and passes after it
Results for evenly divisible totals are unchanged
outOfScope: Switching to a largest-remainder distribution strategy
Changes to any module other than allocate

failingOnBase: test/allocate.test.ts > allocate > hands leftover minor units to the first shares
test/allocate.test.ts > allocate > never loses or creates a minor unit
